title.en: Update this firstmate to upstream main (14 commits behind)
title.hant: 把這個 firstmate 更新到 upstream main（落後 14 個 commit）

decide.en: Update now, or wait until the board PR lands?
decide.hant: 現在更新，還是等看板的 PR 合併再一起？

about.en: Upstream gained 14 commits since this home last synced, including 3eb5b633 'settle terminal contribution observations', which looks like the fix for the merged-PR read failures that woke you four times today.
about.hant: 這個 home 上次同步後 upstream 多了 14 個 commit，其中 3eb5b633「settle terminal contribution observations」看起來就是今天叫你四次的已合併 PR 讀取失敗的修法。

if_nothing.en: The noisy wake keeps arriving about every ten minutes, and the next PR is rebased on a main this home does not run yet.
if_nothing.hant: 那個噪音每十分鐘左右繼續來，而且下一個 PR 是 rebase 在這個 home 還沒跑的 main 上。

reversible_note.en: The update is a guarded fast-forward through /updatefirstmate; a bad update is undone by checking out the previous main commit.
reversible_note.hant: 更新走 /updatefirstmate 的 guarded fast-forward；出問題 checkout 回上一個 main commit 就好。

consequence.en: This session restarts on the new main; the contribution fix is live within minutes.
consequence.hant: 這個 session 會在新的 main 上重啟；contribution 的修法幾分鐘內生效。

label.hant: 等看板 PR 合併後

consequence.en: One restart instead of two, but the noisy wake stays until then.
consequence.hant: 只重啟一次，但噪音會持續到那時候。

recommend_why.en: The fix is upstream and unrelated to the PR; every hour of delay is six more empty wakes.
recommend_why.hant: 修法已在 upstream 而且跟 PR 無關；每多等一小時就多六個空喚醒。

what.en: Board PR opened on the fork: trilingual five-question cards
what.hant: 看板 PR 已在 fork 上開出：三語五問卡片

what.en: Merge PR 142: ParaSwap to Velora API migration
what.hant: 合併 PR 142：ParaSwap 換到 Velora API

what.en: baton collapsed into one /baton personal skill
what.hant: baton 合併成單一 /baton 個人 skill

title.en: Contributions poll: 5 s per-call bound below GitHub latency
title.hant: Contributions poll：5 秒上限低於 GitHub 延遲

title.en: Fleet v2 phase 1: worker-produced decision packet in the definition of done
title.hant: Fleet v2 第一階段：worker 自產 decision packet 進 DoD
